h: Tems opens up about living with ADHD
p: Grammy-winning singer Tems has spoken about how ADHD affects her relationships, saying she finds it hard to keep in touch with people and sometimes switches topics mid-conversation.
body: Nigerian singer Temilade Openiyi, known as Tems, has opened up about living with Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) and how it affects her relationships with family and friends.
In a radio interview in Lagos, the singer said keeping in touch with people is something she finds difficult, even though she has many supportive people around her.

She explained that ADHD sometimes makes her switch topics suddenly during conversations, and that she often forgets to reach out to people. She admitted she has not always been consistent in communicating with people who matter to her, but said she is trying.
Tems leads the Nigerian nominees for the 2027 Grammy Awards with four nominations.
more: She says ADHD makes it hard to keep in touch.
She leads Nigerian Grammy nominees this year.
